judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped mid-implementation (leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree with unchecked items and `Status | In Progress` in `spec.md`). In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it uses a default import (`import Ajv from 'ajv'`) instead of a named import (`import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`), which breaks ESM runtime/TypeScript execution (`new Ajv(...)` fails under Node ESM when `ajv`'s CJS module is default-imported without interop). Furthermore, it misses most of the acceptance criteria: `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` only has 1 of the required unit tests (putting 4 tests in a separate `registry.acceptance.test.ts` and completely omitting tests for extra properties, dynamic schema changes, static schema single-compile, and unknown tool throw), `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` was not updated, and none of `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were updated.
